name: Typo-Tolerant Search with Levenshtein Edit Distance & Length Bounds
description: Users frequently misspell search terms (e.g. 'postgre' -> 'postgresql'). Levenshtein distance counts insertions, deletions, and substitutions.
prompt:
Users frequently misspell search terms (e.g. 'postgre' -> 'postgresql'). Levenshtein distance counts insertions, deletions, and substitutions.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: keyword_id, keyword, edit_distance.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Find keywords within edit distance <= 2 of search query 'posgresql'
            SELECT 
                keyword_id,
                keyword,
                levenshtein(keyword, 'posgresql') AS edit_distance
            FROM catalog_keywords
            -- Pre-filter: word length cannot differ by more than max allowed edit distance (2)
            WHERE ABS(LENGTH(keyword) - LENGTH('posgresql')) <= 2
              AND levenshtein(keyword, 'posgresql') <= 2
            ORDER BY edit_distance ASC;
why_it_fails: Computing Levenshtein distance on every catalog word is CPU intensive without pre-filtering on string length (ABS(len_a - len_b) <= max_distance).
